name: Cod, Spinach & Cilantro Coconut Curry with Spicy Mango-Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 limes
3 mangoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop spinach and transfer to a medium bowl; set aside.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and ginger; cook, stirring constantly, until golden, 1-2 minutes.
Add spices to the pot and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut milk, then bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
While the coconut milk is heating up, pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Once the coconut milk is boiling, reduce heat to medium-low, add cod, and simmer, undisturbed, until the fish is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, zest and juice limes into another medium bowl; add oil, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumbers, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice crosswise into half-moons; add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallots; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl (reserving the rest for the curry) and stir to combine the salad.
When the curry is done, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the fish curry between bowls and sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Enjoy with mango-cucumber salad on the side.
